My name is Gabe Alencar and I’m a senior studying Computer Engineering at Harvey Mudd College. I’m especially interested in RISC‑V design/verification and how hardware can better support modern AI workloads. As a student‑athlete playing Division III football at Claremont‑Mudd‑Scripps, I’ve maintained a rigorous engineering curriculum while developing strong time management and leadership skills. In the future, I hope to combine my passion for AI and digital design to work on next‑generation computing systems.
